about: Two switches after one move, in play: a U-turn that hits an Eject Button holder sends the holder back and leaves its user in (Pokemon Central, Pulsantefuga; Showdown's gen-9 ejectbutton clears the pivot's switch) -- battle_controller_player.c's post-move steps, where the button's switch comes first and U-turn's is not made for a target that left (PivotSwitchPending, Battler_CameInAfterTheHit), the C that does the work of the reference's SetCurrentMoveSwitchingStatus pending order (a stub here, test_battle_commands). In the Violet Gym the Snorlax is taught U-turn and Falkner's Hoothoot is given an Eject Button (teach:, set:); the Snorlax hits it, the Hoothoot goes back and Falkner sends out his Doduo, and the Snorlax is still out, the party screen never opened.
